Add test coverage for form generation tool
body:
## Context

The \`generate_form\` tool (\`src/tools/generate-form.ts\`) generates production-ready forms but has limited test coverage. It supports 8 preset types and multiple frameworks.

## Task

Add unit tests for the form generation tool:

**What to test:**
- Each of the 8 preset types generates valid output (login, signup, contact, checkout, settings, search, newsletter, custom)
- Framework-specific output (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, HTML)
- Validation schema generation (Zod, Yup)
- Multi-step form configuration
- Brand identity parameter integration
- WCAG accessibility attributes (labels, aria-describedby)

**Setup:**
\`\`\`bash
npm ci
npm run build  # Required before testing
NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest
\`\`\`

## Helpful context

- Test examples: \`src/__tests__/\` (35 existing suites)
- Uses Jest ESM with ts-jest preset
- Form tool schema defined with Zod
- Tool handler pattern: \`async (params) => ({ content: [...] })\`

title: Improve error messages in generation API
body:
## Context

The generation API route (`apps/web/src/app/api/generate/route.ts`) returns generic error messages when generation fails. User-friendly error messages would help users understand what went wrong.

## Task

Improve error messages in the generation API:

- **Missing API key** — "No API key configured for [provider]. Add your key in Settings > API Keys"
- **Rate limited** — "Generation limit reached. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited generations"
- **Invalid prompt** — "Prompt is too short. Describe what you want to generate in at least 10 characters"
- **Provider error** — "AI provider returned an error. Try again or switch to a different provider"

**Where:**
- `apps/web/src/app/api/generate/route.ts` — main API route
- Error response format: `{ error: string, code: string, suggestion?: string }`

## Helpful context

- Usage tracking: `apps/web/src/lib/usage/` checks quotas before generation
- Feature flags: `apps/web/src/lib/features/` controls billing features
- Current error handling returns `{ error: err.message }` — needs structure

title: Add loading skeletons to dashboard pages
body:
## Context Dashboard pages (projects list, generation history, settings) show a blank screen while data loads. Adding skeleton loading states improves perceived performance. ## Task Add skeleton loading states to these pages: - **Projects list** (`apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/projects/`) — card grid with skeleton cards - **Generation page** (`apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/generate/`) — skeleton for history sidebar - **Settings page** (`apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/settings/`) — skeleton for form fields **Implementation:** - Use shadcn/ui's `Skeleton` component (already in `packages/ui/src/components/ui/`) - Add loading states to the TanStack Query hooks (check `isLoading` state) - Match the layout of the actual content so there's no layout shift ## Example \`\`\`tsx if (isLoading) { return (
{Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => ( ))}
); } \`\`\` ## Helpful context - Existing Skeleton component: `packages/ui/src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx` - TanStack Query hooks: check `apps/web/src/hooks/` for `use-projects.ts`, etc. - Dark-only UI — no light mode considerations

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
body:
## Context

The generator page (`apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/generate/`) currently requires mouse interaction for all actions. Adding keyboard shortcuts would improve power user experience.

## Task

Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions in the generator page:

- **Cmd/Ctrl + Enter** — Submit generation prompt
- **Cmd/Ctrl + K** — Focus the prompt input
- **Cmd/Ctrl + S** — Save generated component as template
- **Escape** — Close modals/sheets

**Where to implement:**
- Create a `useKeyboardShortcuts` hook in `apps/web/src/hooks/`
- Wire into `ComponentGenerator.tsx` or the generate page layout
- Show shortcuts in tooltips (e.g., "Generate (⌘↵)")

## Helpful context

- Existing hooks: `apps/web/src/hooks/` 
- The app uses shadcn/ui `Dialog` and `Sheet` components (Radix-based)
- Platform detection: `navigator.platform` for Cmd vs Ctrl

title: Add unit tests for billing components
body:
## Context

The billing components in `apps/web/src/components/billing/` have no test coverage. These are straightforward React components that render pricing cards, subscription status, usage charts, and upgrade prompts.

## Task

Write unit tests for the billing components using Jest + React Testing Library.

**Files to test:**
- `PricingCard.tsx` — renders plan name, price, features list
- `SubscriptionStatus.tsx` — shows current plan and status
- `UsageChart.tsx` — renders usage data with progress bars
- `UpgradePrompt.tsx` — shows upgrade CTA based on usage limits

**What to cover:**
- Component renders correctly with mock props
- Conditional rendering (e.g., "Current Plan" badge, limit warnings)
- Button click handlers fire correctly

**Setup:**
```bash
npm ci
cd apps/web && npx jest --forceExit
```

## Helpful context

- Test examples: `apps/web/src/__tests__/` (19 existing suites)
- UI components use shadcn/ui pattern (Radix + Tailwind)
- Mock Supabase client for data fetching tests

## 🎋 Add New Japan Fact

**Category:** Community Contribution - Fun Fact  
**Difficulty:** Easy (good first issue!)  
**Estimated Time:** <1 min

---

### 🎯 Your Task

Add this interesting fact about Japan to our collection!

### The Fact

> The word 'yoroshiku' (よろしく) has no direct translation - it's used for introductions, requests, and meaning 'please treat me well'.

### 📝 Instructions

1. Star our repo ⭐
2. Fork our repo 🍴
3. Open [`community/content/japan-facts.json`](../blob/main/community/content/japan-facts.json) in your browser (click the link!)
4. Scroll to the bottom of the file and paste the following fact just before the closing `]`:

```json
"The word 'yoroshiku' (よろしく) has no direct translation - it's used for introductions, requests, and meaning 'please treat me well'."
```

5. Add a comma after the previous last entry in the array (so the JSON stays valid)
6. Save the file and commit the changes
7. Submit a Pull Request with title: `content: add new japan fact`
8. Link this issue using `Closes #<issue_number>`
9. Wait for review!

---
